title: Data models
expectation: Foundation unit: see the instructions.md SECTION; done when the exported symbols are complete and the build passes

title: Utilities
expectation:
DATA-A21 After an SMS code is fetched successfully, the system notification bar shows a high-priority notification titled `验证码` with content `您的验证码是` plus the code (channel `验证码通知`)
DATA-A22 SMS login/registration pages request notification permission first. Permanent denial toasts 通知权限被永久拒绝，请手动授予 (built from the `被永久拒绝，请手动授予` template), plain denial toasts 通知权限获取失败 (built from the `获取失败` template)
DATA-A23 Input validation rules: phone matches 1[3-9] + 9 digits (11 digits), SMS code is 4 digits, image captcha is 4 letters/digits, password is at least 6 characters
DATA-A24 Chat time formatting: today shows HH:mm, other days show yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm. A time divider appears only when two adjacent messages are more than 10 minutes apart

title: Network layer
expectation:
DATA-A01 All business requests go to base URL `https://mall.dusksnow.top/app/` (same for the dev and prod flavors) plus a relative path, sent as JSON with unknown response fields ignored
DATA-A02 Main API client connect/read/write timeouts are 10 seconds each, and it retries on connection failure
DATA-A03 When a token is stored locally, every business request carries header `Authorization` set to the raw token value (no `Bearer` prefix). Without a token the header is omitted
DATA-A04 Every API response is parsed as an envelope { data, code, message }, and only `code == 1000` counts as success
DATA-A05 On a business failure (code != 1000), the caller gets the server message (fallback `未知错误`), and with showToast on an error toast appears. Exceptions/network errors fall back to `网络请求失败`. There is no 401/token-expiry interception: no auto logout or redirect to login
DATA-A06 Paged requests default to page=1, size=10, sort=`desc`. Responses are { list, pagination{ total, size, page } }, and there is a next page if `size*page < total`
DATA-A19 Image upload works in two steps: first `base/comm/upload` returns temporary credentials and a url, then a multipart POST to that url (fields key=`app/base/{uuid}_image.{ext}`, tmpSecretId, tmpSecretKey, sessionToken, file). On success the image address is url + "/" + key
DATA-A20 Batch image upload goes one by one; if any image fails, the whole batch fails with an error message prefixed `批量上传失败`. The upload client uses 30-second timeouts and sends no Authorization header
AUTH-A32 After login, every request carries the stored token in the Authorization header (raw token, no Bearer prefix)

title: Local storage
expectation:
DATA-A14 The cart is purely local (database table `carts`, one row per goodsId, specs stored as a JSON list with count per spec). Adding the same product merges into its row, and the cart is not synced to the server
DATA-A15 When changing a cart spec's quantity, the whole product row is deleted once every spec's quantity is ≤0. Deleting one spec deletes the row when no specs remain
DATA-A16 Viewing a product detail writes a footprint (goodsId as primary key, overwrite, refreshing viewTime). Footprints are sorted by viewTime descending, the "Me" page shows the latest 8, and they can be cleared all at once
DATA-A17 Search history is stored with the trimmed keyword as primary key (blank ignored, a repeated search refreshes its time). It is sorted by time descending and the search page shows the latest 10
DATA-A18 Checkout data passes through persistence keys `carts` (cart items selected for checkout) and `selectedGoodsList` (selected goods), both cleared after an order is placed. Theme uses `settings_theme_mode`/`settings_theme_color`, the onboarding flag uses `guide_shown`, and remembered account uses `saved_phone`/`saved_password`
DATA-A25 Local database name is `coolmall-database` (version 1), with the three tables `carts`, `footprints`, `search_history`. List queries are observable, and the UI refreshes automatically when data changes

title: Global state/repositories/navigation
expectation:
LAUNCH-A19 At startup, login state is restored from the local `auth_info` record: it counts as logged in only when the token is non-empty and not expired (createdAt + expire seconds); only when logged in is user info read from local `user_info` and userId set
LAUNCH-A21 On logout, local `auth_info` and `user_info` are cleared and the in-memory login state is reset to not logged in (userId=0)
LAUNCH-A22 Global route login wall: when not logged in, navigating to profile/address list/address detail/order list/confirm order/order detail/payment/refund/review/logistics/support chat/coupons/feedback list/submit feedback is redirected to the login page (AuthRoutes.Login)
DATA-A07 Login credentials are stored as JSON (token/refreshToken/expire/refreshExpire/createdAt) under persistence key `auth_info`
DATA-A08 Logged in = local auth exists, token is non-empty and not expired (createdAt + expire seconds). An expired token counts as not logged in
DATA-A09 User info (User) is stored as JSON under persistence key `user_info`, and it is read only when logged in
DATA-A10 On cold start the app restores login state and user info from local storage: after login, a restarted app is still logged in and the user's nickname/avatar show without logging in again
DATA-A11 After a successful login, auth and user are written to local storage and memory together, login state becomes true, and then the person-info endpoint is called to refresh user info
DATA-A12 Logging out removes only `auth_info` and `user_info` and resets in-memory login state/userId=0. It calls no server endpoint and does not clear the local cart, footprints, search history or remembered account
DATA-A13 Opening a login-required page (Profile, address list/detail, order list/confirm/detail/pay/refund/comment/logistics, customer-service chat, coupons, feedback list/submit) while not logged in sends the user to the login page instead

title: Theme system
expectation:
LAUNCH-A24 Theme mode supports three modes: `follow_system`/`light`/`dark`; the default is follow system, and dark mode is applied according to the setting
LAUNCH-A25 Theme mode and theme color are persisted to local keys `settings_theme_mode` and `settings_theme_color`; unknown or missing values fall back to follow system / default color
LAUNCH-A26 The theme color offers 5 choices: default `#465CFF`, purple `#6831FF`, green `#09BE4F`, orange `#FFB703`, red `#FF2B2B`; the chosen color replaces the global primary color and takes effect right away, without a restart
LAUNCH-A27 After changing the theme mode/theme color and cold-restarting, the last selection is kept
LAUNCH-A28 Light/dark color tokens: light page background `#F1F4FA`, light card `#FFFFFF`; dark page background `#111111`, dark card `#1B1B1B`; dynamic color (Monet) is off

title: App init and window layer
expectation:
INIT-A01 应用级初始化：Application.onCreate（app/src/main/java/com/joker/coolmall/Application.kt:27-37，5 行）在安卓先于任何页面执行——其中每项初始化须接入 EntryAbility.onCreate 并在首页前完成，无鸿蒙等价的逐项记降级
LAUNCH-A18 At app startup, initialization runs in order: Toast → Log → local KV storage (MMKV) → QQ SDK, and the global login state (AppState.initialize) is restored only after KV storage is ready
LAUNCH-A20 After logging in and cold-restarting the app, the logged-in state and user info are kept (no need to log in again)
LAUNCH-A23 The app is edge-to-edge: page content draws under the status bar and navigation bar, and each page handles safe-area insets itself
LAUNCH-A29 Page transitions use horizontal slides: going forward the new page slides in from the right, going back it slides out to the right; predictive back uses the same back animation
LAUNCH-A30 Navigation commands issued before the navigation host is ready are queued and run in order once the host is attached, so none are lost
LAUNCH-A31 When the back stack has only one page, the in-app back action does not pop the last page (the root page is kept)
LAUNCH-A32 The toast style follows the system dark mode: a light/white toast in dark mode and a black toast in light mode, switching when the system theme changes
LAUNCH-A33 The app display name is `青商城`; the launcher shows the app icon
LAUNCH-A34 At startup the QQ login SDK is initialized with AppId `102756675`, and the QQ login result callback is returned to the login flow through Activity results

title: Splash/guide
expectation:

LAUNCH-A03 The splash background uses the theme surface color and follows light/dark mode (white in light mode, `#1B1B1B` in dark mode)
LAUNCH-A04 Top content avoids the status bar (the logo and text are laid out centered/at the bottom and are not covered by the status bar)
LAUNCH-A05 After the splash page has shown for about 1.2 seconds it navigates away automatically, with no user action needed
LAUNCH-A06 When the local storage key `guide_shown` is not true (first install), the splash page goes to the guide page; otherwise it goes straight to the main page (MainRoutes.Main)
LAUNCH-A07 When the splash page navigates away it removes itself from the back stack; pressing back on the guide/main page does not return to the splash page
LAUNCH-A08 When the splash page goes to the main page, the logo moves via a shared element (key `app_logo`) to the logo position at the top of the home page
LAUNCH-A09 The guide page has 4 horizontally swipeable pages; each shows an illustration, a bold title, and a multi-line description (`青商城 - 开源电商学习项目`, `声明式 UI 新体验`, `完整电商业务流程`, `模块化架构设计`)
LAUNCH-A10 Top content avoids the status bar (the top-right `跳过` button sits inside the Scaffold safe area and is not covered by the status bar)
LAUNCH-A11 The bottom has a page indicator with 4 dots; the dot for the current page is shown highlighted, elongated and opaque, and it updates in sync as the user swipes
LAUNCH-A12 On pages that are not the last one, the bottom button says `继续`; tapping it scrolls to the next page with animation
LAUNCH-A13 On the last page the bottom button text becomes `开始体验` (and the button gets wider)
LAUNCH-A14 In the normal flow (fromSettings=false), tapping `开始体验` or `跳过` writes local storage `guide_shown`=true and then goes to the main page, removing the guide page from the back stack
LAUNCH-A15 After finishing the guide, the next cold start skips the guide page (splash → main page)
LAUNCH-A16 When opened from the settings page's `应用引导` entry (fromSettings=true), tapping `开始体验` or `跳过` only goes back to the previous page (settings); it does not write `guide_shown` and does not go to the main page
LAUNCH-A17 The guide page follows light/dark mode (surface background), and the indicator/button colors follow the current theme primary color

title: Category tab
expectation:
MAIN-A01 Top content of the Category, Cart and Me tabs avoids the status bar (Scaffold content insets, navigation bar excluded only)
MAIN-A02 The Category tab shows a centered title bar `分类` with no back button
MAIN-A03 Opening the Category tab requests the category list once (POST goods/type/list) and builds a tree sorted by sortNum: items with null parentId are first-level categories, the rest attach under their parent by parentId
MAIN-A04 While category data loads, the page shows the category skeleton (left/right two-column placeholders); loading lasts at least 320ms
MAIN-A05 When category loading fails, the page shows the network error state `网络连接失败`/`请检查网络连接后重试` with a `重新加载` button; tapping it requests again
MAIN-A06 After loading, the left column lists all first-level category names, with the first selected by default; the selected item is highlighted with a left indicator bar and cannot be tapped again
MAIN-A07 The right column is one continuously scrolling list: each first-level category shows a lined title (category name) followed by a 3-column grid of its second-level categories (image + name); a category with no children shows only the title
MAIN-A08 Tapping a first-level category on the left scrolls the right list to that category's section
MAIN-A09 When the user scrolls the right list by hand, the left selection follows the category section currently in view (the two are linked, with no feedback loop)
MAIN-A10 Tapping a second-level category goes to the goods category/list page (GoodsRoutes.Category) with that subcategory id as typeId

title: Cart
expectation:
MAIN-A11 The Cart page title is `购物车`; the back arrow shows only when opened standalone with showBackIcon=true (e.g. from the goods detail page's cart entry), and tapping it goes back; on the tab page there is no back arrow
MAIN-A12 Cart data comes from the local database (Room table carts, not tied to the account, no network) and is observed live; any add/remove/count change refreshes the list automatically
MAIN-A13 When the cart is empty, it shows the empty state `购物车是空的`/`快去添加商品吧` (no button) and hides both the top-right edit button and the bottom checkout bar
MAIN-A14 When the cart has items, each goods entry is a card grouped by goods (name/image) listing each spec row: select box, spec name, price (¥ + integer + .00), quantity stepper; tapping the goods card goes to that goods' detail page
MAIN-A15 The select box on each spec row toggles that spec's selected state independently (selection is by goodsId+specId)
MAIN-A16 The quantity stepper changes count by ±1 with a minimum of 1 (minus disabled at 1, no stock cap); the change is written to the local database right away
MAIN-A17 The bottom bar has a `全选` select box: it shows checked when every spec is selected; tapping it when all are selected clears the selection, otherwise it selects every spec
MAIN-A18 In normal mode the bottom bar shows `合计:` + the selected total (Σ price×count of selected specs) and a checkout button: `结算` when nothing is selected (disabled), `结算(%d)` (with the selected spec count) when specs are selected
MAIN-A19 The top-right `编辑` button enters edit mode and changes to `完成`; entering or leaving edit mode clears the current selection; in edit mode the bottom bar replaces total/checkout with a red `删除`/`删除(%d)` button (disabled when nothing is selected)
MAIN-A20 Tapping delete plays a slide-out animation and then deletes the selected specs: when all specs of a goods are selected the whole goods is deleted, otherwise only the selected specs; a goods whose last spec is removed is deleted too; after deletion the selection is cleared and edit mode ends
MAIN-A21 On checkout, it toasts `请选择要结算的商品` when nothing is selected; otherwise it writes the selected cart items (selected specs only) to MMKV key `carts`, writes them converted into a SelectedGoods list to MMKV key `selectedGoodsList`, then goes to the confirm-order page (OrderRoutes.Confirm)
MAIN-A22 When not logged in, tapping checkout goes to the login page instead of the confirm-order page (Confirm is a login-required route)

title: Me tab
expectation:
MAIN-A23 The Me page user area: when logged in it shows avatar, nickname and `手机号` + phone number; when not logged in it shows the default avatar, `未登录` and `点击登录账号`; tapping the area goes to the profile page (when not logged in, to the login page)
MAIN-A24 On entering the Me page, if logged in but with no cached user info, it fetches user info; on every page resume (onResume) it requests order counts when logged in (GET order/info/userCount) and resets all counts to 0 when not logged in
MAIN-A25 The Me page shows a member card `会员立享5大权益!` + `立即开通` (display only, no tap behavior)
MAIN-A26 The order area title `我的订单` + `查看全部` goes to the all-orders list; the five entries `待付款`/`待发货`/`待收货`/`待评价`/`退款/售后` go to the order list with tab=1/2/3/5/4; each entry with count>0 shows a red badge (退款/售后 = 退款中 + 已退款); when not logged in, every order entry goes to the login page
MAIN-A27 When local footprints exist, it shows the `我的足迹` area: `查看全部` goes to the footprint page, below it a horizontal list of up to 8 most recent footprint images (by browse time, newest first), tapping one goes to goods detail; when there are no footprints the area is hidden
MAIN-A28 The function menu has, in order, `优惠券`→coupon page, `收货地址`→address list, `在线客服`→customer-service chat, `意见反馈`→feedback list, `关于我们`→about page; a separate card holds `设置`→settings page; coupon/address/chat/feedback go to the login page when not logged in

title: Main shell + home
expectation:
HOME-A01 The main shell has a bottom navigation bar with 4 tabs in a fixed order: `主页`, `分类`, `购物车`, `我的`; the Home tab is selected by default at startup
HOME-A02 Tapping a bottom tab switches to that tab's page, and the selected tab's label shows in the primary color while unselected labels are dimmed
HOME-A03 The four tab pages can also be switched by swiping left or right (horizontal pager), and the selected bottom tab stays in sync with the page swiped to
HOME-A04 The selected tab icon plays its animation once (Lottie: home/category/cart/me), and unselected icons stay on the first frame
HOME-A05 The home top content avoids the status bar (TopAppBar handles the status bar inset; the bottom bar avoids the navigation bar)
HOME-A06 The home top bar has the app logo on the left (tapping opens the About page), a search box in the middle with the placeholder `搜索商品` (tapping opens the goods search page), and a GitHub icon on the right (tapping opens a built-in web page with the title `GitHub` loading https://github.com/Joker-x-dev/CoolMallKotlin)
HOME-A07 The home top bar collapses as the content scrolls up and reappears on scroll down (enterAlways)
HOME-A08 During the first load the home page shows a dedicated skeleton screen (banner/coupon/category/flash sale/title/recommended placeholders) instead of a generic loader, and it stays at least 320ms
HOME-A09 When the home page opens it requests the home aggregate API (GET page/home), and the response fills the banner, coupon, category, flash sale, recommended goods and first page of all goods all at once
HOME-A10 When the home data fails to load, the page shows the network error state `网络连接失败`/`请检查网络连接后重试`, and tapping `重新加载` requests the home data again
HOME-A11 The banner carousel shows the banner images at a 2:1 ratio, autoplays every 3 seconds in a loop with page indicators, and banners do not respond to taps
HOME-A12 When there are coupons, the coupon bar shows coupon titles you can swipe through (no autoplay, no indicator), with a `领取` link on the right; tapping it opens the `领取优惠券` bottom sheet listing all home coupons
HOME-A13 Tapping receive on a coupon in the sheet: when not logged in, the sheet closes and the app goes to the login page; when logged in, it calls POST market/coupon/user/receive (couponId), and on success shows the success toast message returned by the server
HOME-A14 The category area shows categories in a grid of 5 per row (round image + name), with blank space filling any incomplete row
HOME-A15 Tapping a home category goes to the goods category list page, passing as typeId the comma-joined IDs of all child categories in categoryAll whose parentId equals that category
HOME-A16 The flash sale card has the title `限时精选` with a `查看全部` entry on the right (tapping opens the goods category list with featured=true), and below it a horizontally scrolling list of goods (image/one-line title/price); tapping a good opens its detail page
HOME-A17 When home goods data exists, it shows a `推荐商品` section title followed by the recommended goods as a vertical list (horizontal list rows), and tapping one opens goods detail
HOME-A18 Under the `全部商品` section title, all goods show as a two-column staggered grid, and tapping a good opens goods detail
HOME-A19 Scrolling to within 3 items of the end of the grid triggers load more: it requests POST goods/info/page (page starting at 2, size=10) and appends the results to the all goods list; when there is no next page it shows `没有更多了`, and on failure it shows a tap-to-retry state and rolls back the page number
HOME-A20 Pull-to-refresh resets the page number to 1 and requests page/home again, replacing all the home section data and the all goods list; refresh is ignored while a load is in progress
HOME-A21 Home sections are shown conditionally: when banner/coupon/category/flashSale/goods in the home data is null, that section (or its section title) is not shown

title: Goods detail/comments
expectation:
GOODS-A01 When the detail page opens, it requests the product detail by goodsId (goodsInfo + coupon list + comment list); while loading it shows the detail skeleton screen, and on failure it shows the network error state with a retry button that requests again
GOODS-A02 When the detail loads successfully, it shows from top to bottom: the image carousel (no autoplay), the price (the selected spec's price if a spec is selected, otherwise the product price) with the sold tag `已售 %d`, the title, the subtitle, and the spec selection row
GOODS-A03 When the detail returns a non-empty coupon list, coupon tags `满%d减%d元` are shown below the price; tapping any tag opens the coupon bottom sheet `领取优惠券`
GOODS-A04 Tapping claim in the coupon sheet: when not logged in, it closes the sheet and goes to the login page; when logged in, it calls the claim-coupon API with couponId and shows a success toast with the returned text
GOODS-A05 The spec row shows `选择规格` when no spec is selected and `已选：%s` (the spec name) when one is; tapping it opens the spec selection bottom sheet titled `选择规格`
GOODS-A06 The spec list is requested by goodsId only after the spec sheet has fully expanded; once loaded successfully it is not requested again, and inside the sheet loading shows a loading indicator while failure shows the network error state with retry
GOODS-A07 In the spec sheet, tapping a spec selects it and tapping the selected spec again deselects it; the header shows `¥` price, `已选`/`未选择`, and `库存`; the spec area can switch between grid and list views
GOODS-A08 The `数量` stepper in the spec sheet appears only after a spec is selected; quantity defaults to 1 and cannot go below 1
GOODS-A09 The sheet's `加入购物车` and `立即购买` buttons are enabled only when a spec is selected and its stock is > 0; otherwise they are disabled
GOODS-A10 Add to cart writes to the local cart (no login check): if the same product and spec already exist, the quantity adds up; same product with a new spec appends that spec; otherwise a new cart entry is created; on success the sheet closes and `添加购物车成功` is shown, and invalid parameters show `添加购物车失败`
GOODS-A11 Buy now writes [SelectedGoods(goodsId, goodsInfo, spec, count)] into local storage key `selectedGoodsList`, closes the spec sheet, and goes to the order confirm page
GOODS-A12 Bottom action bar of the detail page: `客服` goes to the support chat page, `购物车` goes to the cart page (with a back button), and both `加入购物车` and `立即购买` open the spec selection sheet
GOODS-A13 The detail page shows the `发货与服务` card: `发货` `云南省 昆明市`, `服务` `7天无理由退货 · 运费险 · 48小时发货`
GOODS-A14 Only when the detail has comments does it show the `商品评价` card (right side `查看全部`); each comment shows the nickname (`匿名用户` when empty), star rating, content, and first image with a `+N` count badge; tapping the title or any comment goes to that product's comment page
GOODS-A15 At the bottom of the detail page, the `商品详情` section shows all rich-text detail images in order
GOODS-A16 The detail page has a floating top bar (back button returns to the previous page; the share button does nothing); the top bar background goes from transparent to opaque as the page scrolls (white in light mode, black in dark mode)
GOODS-A17 Detail page: top content avoids the status bar (the carousel extends under the status bar, and the floating top bar buttons avoid it)
GOODS-A18 After the detail loads successfully, a browsing footprint is written locally (goodsId as unique key, with name/subtitle/main image/price/sold count/browse time); a failed write does not affect the page
GOODS-A19 The comment page title is `商品评论` with a back button; while loading it shows the comment skeleton screen, with no data it shows the empty state, and on failure it shows the network error state with retry
GOODS-A20 The comment page requests comment pages by goodsId (10 per page) and supports pull-to-refresh and load-more near the bottom; when every page has loaded it shows no more data
GOODS-A21 Each comment card shows the nickname (`匿名用户` when empty), comment time, 5-star rating, content (when non-empty), and an image grid (at most 9 images, 3 per row)
GOODS-A22 Comment page: top content avoids the status bar

title: Search/goods list
expectation:
GOODS-A23 When the search page opens, it requests the recommended search keyword list and also subscribes to the 10 most recent local search history entries (newest first; the list refreshes as soon as it changes)
GOODS-A24 The search page top bar has a back button, an input box (placeholder `输入内容进行搜索`), and a `搜索` button (keyboard search also submits); below it, `搜索历史` is shown only when history exists (a delete icon on the right clears all history), followed by the `推荐搜索` tags
GOODS-A25 Submitting a non-blank keyword (input box / history tag / recommended tag) first writes search history (trimmed, deduplicated by keyword with the time refreshed), then goes to the category product list carrying that keyword; a blank keyword does nothing
GOODS-A26 Search page: top content avoids the status bar
GOODS-A27 The category product list reads route parameters: typeId (comma-separated category ids, preselected as filters), featured, recommend, keyword (also pre-filled in the search box), and minPrice (pre-filled as the minimum price when arriving from a coupon)
GOODS-A28 The product list requests by page (10 per page) with: category ids, min/max price, keyword, sort field (sold/price) and direction (asc/desc), recommend, featured; empty conditions are not sent
GOODS-A29 The sort bar has `综合`, `销量`, and `价格`: tapping `综合` clears sorting; first tap on `销量`/`价格` sorts ascending, tapping again sorts descending, and a third tap goes back to `综合`; the up/down arrows highlight the current direction, and every sort change refreshes the list from page 1
GOODS-A30 Tapping `筛选` opens the filter overlay; on first open only, the category list is requested and built into a parent-child tree (sorted by sortNum, nested by parentId); the overlay shows loading while the request is in progress and the network error state on failure
GOODS-A31 The filter overlay has the title `筛选` and a close button, a `价格区间` row with numeric inputs `最低价`/`最高价`, and one card per top-level category whose child categories are multi-select chips (icon + name); `重置` clears the conditions and refreshes the list (the overlay stays open), `确定` applies the conditions, closes the overlay and refreshes the list, and tapping the mask closes it without applying
GOODS-A32 The category page defaults to a two-column grid; the button at the right of the top bar toggles grid/list, and when the top bar collapses on scroll, the toggle button appears at the right end of the sort bar
GOODS-A33 The category page shows a skeleton screen while loading, the empty state with no data, and the network error state with retry on failure; the list supports pull-to-refresh and load-more, and tapping a product goes to its detail page
GOODS-A34 Submitting from the category page's own search box re-queries the list with the new keyword (no keyword condition when empty) and does not write search history
GOODS-A35 Category product list page: top content avoids the status bar

title: Order list
expectation:
ORDA-A01 On all three pages (order list, order detail, logistics), the top content avoids the status bar (edge-to-edge; the AppScaffold top bar takes the status bar inset)
ORDA-A02 Order list, order detail and logistics all require login: when not logged in, navigating to any of these three routes is redirected to the login page
ORDA-A03 The order list page title is `订单列表`, and the top bar has a back button that returns to the previous page

No next page (pagination.size*page >= total) shows "no more"; on load-more failure, the page number rolls back and an error state is shown so the user can trigger it again

title: Confirm order/checkout
expectation:
ORDB-A01 On all four pages (Confirm/Pay/Refund/Comment) the top content (large title bar) avoids the status bar
ORDB-A02 Confirm, Pay, Refund, and Comment are all login-required routes: when not logged in, navigating to them goes to the login page instead
ORDB-A03 The confirm order page title is `确认订单`; while loading it shows the confirm-order skeleton, and on load failure it shows the network-error empty state, where tapping retry requests again
ORDB-A04 On entry the confirm order page requests page/confirmOrder to get the default address (defaultAddress) and the user's coupons (userCoupon)
ORDB-A05 The confirm page's item list is read first from local cache key `carts` (from the cart), otherwise from `selectedGoodsList` (buy now from goods detail, grouped by goodsId and converted to an item card with multiple specs); both cache keys are deleted immediately after reading
ORDB-A06 The address card on the confirm page shows the default address (with none it shows `您还没有选择收货地址`/`点击添加收货地址`); tapping it opens the address list in select mode, and the address chosen there and passed back replaces the current page's address

ORDB-A08 Item total = sum over all specs of price×count; with a coupon selected, the discount equals the coupon amount only when the total ≥ the coupon's condition.fullAmount, otherwise 0 (also 0 when the coupon has no condition); total = total − discount, with a floor of 0
ORDB-A09 Tapping the `优惠券` row opens the `选择优惠券` bottom sheet listing userCoupon; a card whose threshold is not met by the current item total shows `不满足条件`, used/expired cards show `已使用`/`已过期`, the selected one shows `已选择`, and a selectable one shows a `选择` button; selecting closes the sheet and recalculates prices
ORDB-A10 The confirm page has an `订单备注` input (label `订单备注`, placeholder `选填，付款后商家可见`, multi-line), and its content is submitted as the order remark
ORDB-A11 Only after loading succeeds does the confirm page bottom bar show, with the total price and a `提交订单` button
ORDB-A12 When submitting the order with no address, toast error `请选择收货地址` and do not submit; otherwise call order/info/create (addressId, goodsList=selectedGoodsList, title=`购买商品`, remark, couponId), and on failure toast the error message
ORDB-A13 After the order is created successfully, if the items came from the cart, remove the ordered items from the local cart (delete the whole item when all its specs were ordered, otherwise delete per spec)
ORDB-A14 After the order is created successfully, the confirm page closes and goes to the payment page, carrying orderId, amount = price − discountPrice, and from=confirm
ORDB-A15 The payment page title is `收银台`; the middle shows the amount `¥<price>.00` in large text, the payment method list `支付宝支付` (fixed selected), `微信支付`, `QQ支付` (unselected, not switchable), and the tip `提示：实际支付金额经过处理，都是一分钱`

ORDB-A19 Payment result mapping: resultStatus `9000` → toast `支付成功`; `6001` → toast `支付已取消`; anything else → toast `支付失败`
ORDB-A20 After payment ends or on back (title-bar back and system back are both intercepted): if from=confirm, always return and open the order detail page for that order; otherwise on success return to the previous page with a refresh signal (RefreshResult refresh=true), and on failure/cancel/back just return

expectation:

AUTH-A06 After QQ login succeeds, it shows the success toast `登录成功`, persists Auth, sets the logged-in state, refreshes user info, and pops back once (leaves the login selection page)
AUTH-A07 The selection page, account login, and SMS login pages show the user agreement line `登录即代表您已阅读并同意` + `《用户协议》` + `和` + `《隐私政策》`; tapping either link opens the user agreement / privacy policy page respectively (register page prefix is `注册即代表您已阅读并同意`)
AUTH-A08 Account login, SMS login, and register pages show the two-line title `你好，` + `欢迎登录青商城` / `欢迎注册青商城`; the reset password page title is `重置密码`
AUTH-A09 The phone input field shows the `+86` prefix and the placeholder `请输入手机号`; the password field placeholder is `请输入密码` and it is masked by default; tapping the eye icon toggles show/hide password
AUTH-A10 Phone validation rule: exactly 11 digits matching ^1[3-9]\d{9}$; SMS code: exactly 4 digits; password: at least 6 characters (no other strength rules)
AUTH-A11 The account login page `登录` button is disabled until the phone is valid and the password is at least 6 characters
AUTH-A12 Account login submits phone+password to POST user/login/password; when the phone is invalid it shows the toast `请输入正确的手机号`, and when the password is invalid it shows `请输入正确的密码` without sending a request
AUTH-A13 After account login succeeds, it saves the phone and password locally (MMKV keys saved_phone / saved_password), shows `登录成功`, persists Auth and sets the logged-in state, refreshes user info, then pops back twice (back past the selection page to the page before login)
AUTH-A14 When the account login page opens, it prefills the phone number and password saved from the last successful login
AUTH-A15 The account login page bottom has `去注册` | `忘记密码`; tapping them goes to the register page / reset password page respectively
AUTH-A16 The SMS code input accepts digits only and at most 4 characters; the `获取验证码` text on its right is clickable only when the phone is valid (greyed and not clickable otherwise); there is no countdown after sending
AUTH-A17 On the SMS login and register pages, tapping `获取验证码` first requests notification permission; when denied it shows the toast `需要通知权限才能接收验证码` and does not continue
AUTH-A18 After permission is granted and the phone is valid, it calls GET user/login/captcha to fetch the image captcha (captchaId + base64 image) and then opens the image captcha dialog; when the phone is invalid it shows `请输入正确的手机号`
AUTH-A19 The image captcha dialog (bottom sheet) has title `安全验证`, input placeholder `请输入图形验证码` (digits only, at most 4), the captcha image on the right, and button `完成验证` which is enabled only when 4 characters are entered
AUTH-A20 Tapping the captcha image fetches a new captcha; when the image is empty or fails to decode, it shows a `点击刷新` placeholder that refreshes when tapped
AUTH-A21 After tapping `完成验证`, the dialog closes and clears the image captcha input, and it calls POST user/login/smsCode with phone, captchaId, code (image captcha)
AUTH-A22 After the SMS code API succeeds, the returned code is shown as a high-priority system notification titled `验证码` with content `您的验证码是: <code>` (the demo backend returns the code directly instead of sending a real SMS)
AUTH-A23 The SMS login `登录` button is enabled only when the phone is valid and the code is 4 digits; tapping it calls POST user/login/phone (phone, smsCode); an invalid code shows the toast `请输入4位验证码`
AUTH-A24 After SMS login succeeds, it saves the phone (saved_phone), shows `登录成功`, persists Auth/logged-in state, refreshes user info, and pops back twice; on next entry to SMS login the phone is prefilled
AUTH-A25 The SMS login page bottom shows `短信不可用？` with `使用三方登录`; tapping the latter returns to the login method selection page
AUTH-A31 All login/register success paths persist Auth{token, refreshToken, expire, refreshExpire, createdAt} as JSON under the local key auth_info and set isLoggedIn=true; logged-in means auth_info exists, token is non-empty, and it is not past createdAt+expire seconds
AUTH-A33 After a successful login, the app is still logged in after a cold restart (state restored from auth_info at startup)
